artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p > 3 be a prime. Define the central Delannoy numbers by
  D_n = ∑_{k=0}^n C(n,k) C(n+k,k),
and the large Schröder numbers by
  S_n = ∑_{k=0}^n C(n+k, 2k) C_k = ∑_{k=0}^n (1/(k+1)) C(n,k) C(n+k,k),
where C_k = C(2k,k)/(k+1) is the k-th Catalan number. Let q_p(2) = (2^{p−1} − 1)/p be the Fermat quotient of p in base 2, let H_m = ∑_{j=1}^m 1/j be harmonic numbers, and let B_n be the n-th Bernoulli number.

Prove or disprove the following congruences:

(a) ∑_{k=1}^{p−1} D_k / k ≡ − q_p(2) + p · q_p(2)^2 (mod p^2).

(b) ∑_{n=1}^{p−1} D_n S_n ≡ − 2p H_{(p−1)/2} + (4/3) p^3 B_{p−3} ≡ − 2p ∑_{k=1}^{p−1} (3 + (−1)^k)/k (mod p^4).

(c) ∑_{n=1}^{(p−1)/2} D_n S_n ≡ 4x^2 (mod p) if p ≡ 1 (mod 4) with p = x^2 + y^2 and x odd, and ∑_{n=1}^{(p−1)/2} D_n S_n ≡ 0 (mod p) if p ≡ 3 (mod 4).
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has established the main supercongruences in this conjecture: the mod p^2 evaluation of ∑_{k=1}^{p-1} D_k/k in terms of the Fermat quotient q_p(2), and the mod p^4 supercongruence for ∑_{n=1}^{p-1} D_n S_n involving H_{(p-1)/2} and B_{p-3}, have been proved (Liu, Pan, and others, in works on arithmetic properties of Delannoy and Schröder numbers, ca. 2016–2017). The half-range mod p evaluation (p = x^2 + y^2 case) appears to also be addressed in this literature, though it is harder to verify a complete proof of every clause. Status is therefore at least partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Arithmetic properties of Delannoy numbers and Schröder numbers
status_evidence.snippet: Studies arithmetic/congruence properties of D_n and S_n, including supercongruences modulo p^2 and p^4.
status_evidence.claim: Proves Sun-type congruences involving Delannoy and Schröder numbers.

status_evidence.title: A supercongruence involving Delannoy numbers and Schröder numbers
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes a supercongruence for ∑ D_k S_k modulo p^4 conjectured by Z.-W. Sun.
status_evidence.claim: The mod p^4 congruence for ∑_{n=1}^{p-1} D_n S_n is proved.

status_evidence.title: Some congruences involving powers of Delannoy polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Congruences for sums of Delannoy numbers/polynomials modulo p^2 in terms of Fermat quotient q_p(2).
status_evidence.claim: The mod p^2 congruence for ∑ D_k/k in terms of q_p(2) is established.
